models.label: LEI TUNG COMMERCIAL CENTRE
models.placementReview: Complete unchanged original Tung Sing tower, Lei Tung government podium and commercial platform. All12751 provider/root-decoded and literal-rendered faces have complete exact finite current ground coverage. Thirty-seven steep walls have strictly exposed original vertices and exact original clear-cap paths, with every current foreign basic, all current native bounds, and both other proposed originals independently checked for wall collisions. Strict original and independently literal-rendered P0/T361 footings ground385 ordinary components through unchanged original positive-dimensional interfaces; two complete authored single-opening sleeves have exact finite visual mounting edges within the existing .1m band and supply no structural/root credit. Mandatory source-bound tower/podium and lower/upper platform identities preserve standalone failed coverage and all raw failures. All40 current forms, four retained native actors, foundations, runtime picking/collision/sampler gates pass. The explicitly changed92211-facet terrain proposal includes exact parent consolidation, authenticated original terrain, separately qualified transition/residual and14 literal whole-source-disjoint parent facets. Government building bytes, all attributes/root/pose/elevations remain unchanged; zero AI geometry modelling.
